inputs.query: According to A Compact Guide to Large Language Models, what is an LLM and what does it do?

expectations.expected_response: An LLM is an AI system trained on large amounts of natural-language data to learn language patterns and generate responses to user prompts.
expected_facts: Trained on large amounts of natural-language data.
Learns language patterns and generates responses to user prompts.

evidence.quote: These systems are trained on massive data sets using advanced machine learning algorithms to learn the patterns and structures of human language

inputs.query: Which four developments does A Compact Guide to Large Language Models identify as bringing attention to LLMs?

expectations.expected_response: Advancements in training techniques, increased accessibility, growing computational power, and improved training data.
expected_facts: Advancements in techniques.
Increased accessibility.
Growing computational power.
Improved training data.

evidence.quote: ADVANCEMENTS IN TECHNIQUES
INCREASED ACCESSIBILITY
GROWING COMPUTATIONAL POWER
IMPROVED TRAINING DATA

inputs.query: Name three business uses for LLMs listed in A Compact Guide to Large Language Models.

expectations.expected_response: Examples include chatbots and virtual assistants, code generation and debugging, and summarization and paraphrasing. Other uses listed in the guide are also acceptable.
expected_facts: At least three uses listed on page 5: chatbots, code generation/debugging, sentiment analysis, text classification/clustering, translation, summarization/paraphrasing, or content generation.

evidence.quote: CHATBOTS AND VIRTUAL ASSISTANTS
CODE GENERATION AND DEBUGGING
SUMMARIZATION AND PARAPHRASING

inputs.query: What warning does A Compact Guide to Large Language Models give about using model responses as factual references?

expectations.expected_response: Most LLMs are not trained to be fact machines. Users should fact-check and understand responses before treating them as references.
expected_facts: Most LLMs are not trained to be fact machines.
Fact-check and understand model responses before using them as references.

evidence.quote: It’s always important to fact check and understand the responses before using them as a reference.

inputs.query: According to A Compact Guide to Large Language Models, what are the benefits of hosting and fine-tuning an open source model?

expectations.expected_response: Hosting a suitable smaller model in your own environment keeps data under your control for privacy and governance and helps manage costs. Fine-tuning adapts it to your data and domain.
expected_facts: Hosting the model can keep data under the organization’s control.
Hosting can help manage costs.
Fine-tuning can improve performance on the organization’s specific data/domain.

evidence.quote: This means that you can keep the data in your control for privacy and governance concerns as well as manage your costs.
take open source models and train them to your specific data, greatly improving their performance on your specific domain.

inputs.query: According to All Roads Lead to the Lakehouse, what are the two ways Auto Loader discovers new files?

expectations.expected_response: Directory listing and file notifications.
expected_facts: Directory listing.
File notifications.

evidence.quote: Auto Loader discovers files either through directory listing or file notifications.

inputs.query: How does All Roads Lead to the Lakehouse explain Auto Loader’s exactly-once ingestion behavior?

expectations.expected_response: Auto Loader tracks ingested files in a durable key-value store, deduplicates notifications, and replays work that was not processed after failures.
expected_facts: Durable key-value store tracks ingested files.
Deduplication and replay of unprocessed files support exactly-once ingestion.

evidence.quote: It keeps track of which files have been ingested using a durable key-value store.
If there are any failures, Auto Loader will replay what hasn’t been processed, giving you exactly-once semantics.

inputs.query: According to All Roads Lead to the Lakehouse, what happens to data that does not match an Auto Loader schema?

expectations.expected_response: Auto Loader can rescue mismatched data into a separate column as a JSON string so it can be investigated later.
expected_facts: Mismatched data can be rescued to a separate column.
The rescued data is stored as a JSON string for later investigation.

evidence.quote: Auto Loader has a data rescue capability that will “rescue” all data in a separate column, stored as a JSON string, to investigate later.

inputs.query: Why does All Roads Lead to the Lakehouse prefer Trigger.AvailableNow to Trigger.Once for a finite Auto Loader run?

expectations.expected_response: Both finish after processing data available at the start. Once processes it in a single micro-batch and must discover all files first; AvailableNow discovers and processes concurrently and supports rate limiting.
expected_facts: Both triggers process new data available at the start and then stop.
Once uses a single micro-batch and discovers files first.
AvailableNow supports concurrent discovery/processing and rate limiting.

evidence.quote: With Trigger AvailableNow, Auto Loader can discover and process files concurrently and perform rate limiting, which makes it a preferable alternative to Trigger Once.

inputs.query: How does Making Your Digital Twin Come to Life define a digital twin, and which two data families feed a manufacturing twin?

expectations.expected_response: A digital twin is a virtual model designed to accurately reflect a physical object. Manufacturing twins combine operational technology (OT) sensor/process data with enterprise informational technology (IT) data.
expected_facts: Virtual model reflecting a physical object.
Operational technology (OT) sensor/process data.
Enterprise informational technology (IT) data.

evidence.quote: A virtual model designed to accurately reflect a physical object.
operational technology data (OT)] and enterprise data [informational technology (IT)]

inputs.query: What are the three maturity stages shown in Making Your Digital Twin Come to Life?

expectations.expected_response: Monitor & Alert; Predict & Diagnose; Simulate & Optimize.
expected_facts: Monitor and Alert.
Predict and Diagnose.
Simulate and Optimize.

evidence.quote: Monitor & Alert
Predict & Diagnose
Simulate & Optimize

inputs.query: In the architecture described by Making Your Digital Twin Come to Life, what roles do Azure IoT Hub, Azure Digital Twin, MLflow, and Delta Lake play?

expectations.expected_response: Azure IoT Hub securely ingests edge data into the cloud. Azure Digital Twin models and visualizes process workflows. Databricks MLflow and Delta Lake scale to deliver real-time predictive analytics.
expected_facts: Azure IoT Hub securely ingests edge-to-cloud data.
Azure Digital Twin models and visualizes workflows.
MLflow and Delta Lake support real-time predictive analytics.

evidence.quote: Azure IoT Hub is used to securely ingest data from edge to cloud.
Azure Digital Twin is used to model and visualize process workflows. Databricks MLflow and Delta Lake scale to deliver real-time predictive analytics.

inputs.query: What root cause does Making Your Digital Twin Come to Life give for manufacturing’s struggles with data and AI?

expectations.expected_response: Data architecture. Examples include legacy data historians unable to handle semi-structured/unstructured data, batch-oriented transfers, absent lineage, and siloed systems.
expected_facts: Data architecture is the stated root cause.
Examples include batch-oriented transfer and data silos or legacy architectures or missing lineage.

evidence.quote: Data architecture is the root cause of this struggle.

inputs.query: Using both A Compact Guide to Large Language Models and Making Your Digital Twin Come to Life, explain why a strong data foundation matters for AI applications.

expectations.expected_response: The LLM guide says LLMs must be implemented on a strong data foundation. The digital twin ebook identifies architecture problems such as silos, batch transfers, and limited support for diverse data as barriers to real-time AI. Together they motivate reliable, accessible, integrated data for useful AI.
expected_facts: The LLM guide explicitly calls for a strong data foundation.
The twin ebook identifies data architecture, silos, or batch transfers as barriers.
The synthesis connects integrated/reliable data to useful AI applications.

evidence.quote: LLMs are incredible tools, but they have to be used and implemented on top of this strong data foundation.
Data architecture is the root cause of this struggle.

inputs.query: Connect the ingestion capability described in All Roads Lead to the Lakehouse with the Rolls-Royce challenge in Making Your Digital Twin Come to Life. What makes scalable ingestion relevant?

expectations.expected_response: The ingestion ebook describes scalable incremental file discovery and processing with Auto Loader. The Rolls-Royce case describes legacy systems unable to scale real-time engine sensor ingestion for ML. Both illustrate why ingestion must keep pace with incoming data, although the case study does not say Auto Loader was used.
expected_facts: Auto Loader incrementally discovers/processes new cloud files at scale.
Rolls-Royce legacy systems could not scale real-time engine sensor ingestion for ML.
Do not claim the Rolls-Royce case explicitly used Auto Loader.

evidence.quote: Auto Loader is a data source on Databricks that incrementally and efficiently processes new data files as they arrive in cloud storage
Legacy systems were unable to scale data ingestion of engine sensor data in real time for ML

inputs.query: Compare the roles of MLflow mentioned in A Compact Guide to Large Language Models and the Rolls-Royce case in Making Your Digital Twin Come to Life.

expectations.expected_response: The LLM guide describes MLflow helping a Python user load a Hugging Face transformer as a Python object. The Rolls-Royce case says MLflow speeds deployment of new models and helps reduce incidents of grounded planes.
expected_facts: LLM guide: MLflow makes using Hugging Face transformer models as Python objects easier.
Rolls-Royce case: MLflow speeds model deployment and reduces grounded-plane incidents.

evidence.quote: MLflow to make it very easy for someone with a bit of Python experience to pull any Hugging Face transformer model and use it as a Python object.
MLflow speeds deployment of new models and reduces incidents of grounded planes

inputs.query: Which of those approaches uses a queue, and what queue services does the ebook name for AWS, Azure, and Google?

history.content: According to All Roads Lead to the Lakehouse, what are the two ways Auto Loader discovers files?
The ebook describes directory listing and file notifications.

expectations.expected_response: File notification mode uses queues: AWS SQS, Azure queue storage, and Google Pub/Sub.
expected_facts: File notification mode.
AWS SQS.
Azure queue storage.
Google Pub/Sub.

evidence.quote: in AWS, S3 will send a notification to AWS SQS. On Azure, a notification is sent to Azure queue storage. On Google, it’ll be sent to Pub/Sub.
